messages:
Mira Chen: Starting a quick patch deploy at 2024-08-14T18:00Z -> ETA ~10m. Patch targets rate-limiter auth refresh bug. Can folks ack availability for smoke + rollback owner?
Kevin Patel: I can be primary rollback executor. cc @Jamal Brooks
Jamal Brooks: I'm oncall and monitoring. Will watch errors, p95/p99, and auth spikes.
Anna Lopez: Quick Q — any DB schema changes or migrations? Need toggle?
Mira Chen: No DB changes. Deploy behind feature flag `rl-fix-aug14`. Rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100% in ~5m increments unless we see issues.
Anna Lopez: 👍 Please post the runbook link and smoke checklist when ready.
Mira Chen: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-patch-rl-fix
Mira Chen: Smoke checklist (short):
1) GET /health -> 200
2) Run local `wrk` smoke script against canary endpoint
3) Sample generation correctness (sanity prompt)
4) KV cache hit rate > 80%
Kevin Patel: Rollback criteria (we'll use these triggers):
- error-rate > 1% sustained for 3m
- p99 latency > 500ms sustained 3m
- failed canary functional checks (smoke test failures)
Jamal Brooks: To rollback: `./deployctl rollback --release=canary-rl-fix` or use `/ops rollback canary-rl-fix` (deploy-bot alias). I'll verify observability before/after.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary -> 10% at 18:00Z. I will post status updates here.
Mira Chen: I'll start the canary at :00. Kevin -> you're primary rollback, Jamal -> observability lead, Anna -> smoke checklist owner. Please ack.
Kevin Patel: Ack, I'll be at my laptop and ready to execute.
Anna Lopez: Ack. I'll run smoke at ~18:02 and report results in-thread.
Jamal Brooks: Ack. Dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/rl-fix (watching errors, auth refresh, latency panels). Alerts preconfigured.
deploy-bot: Rollout: 10% at 18:00Z succeeded
Anna Lopez: Smoke 18:02: /health 200, sample gen ok, kv hit 86% — looks nominal
Kevin Patel: Canary stable from 18:01-18:05. p95/p99 in normal range.
Mira Chen: Ramp to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Rollout: 50% at 18:06Z succeeded
Anna Lopez: Running smoke after ramp — seeing small spike in auth errors (5x baseline) on canary nodes, investigating
Jamal Brooks: I can see auth error spike correlated with token refresh calls from canary pods, digging into traces
Kevin Patel: If auth errors > 2% rollback. I recommend reverting to be safe.
Mira Chen: Kevin, go ahead and execute rollback when ready.
Kevin Patel: Executing rollback: ``./deployctl rollback --release=prev-stable && ./deployctl monitor --until=stable``
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by Kevin Patel at 18:09Z. I will update on completion.
Jamal Brooks: Observability shows error rate returning to baseline after rollback trigger; traces cut over to prev-stable tokens.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 18:12Z. Canary removed, traffic restored to prev-stable. No open alerts.
Mira Chen: Thanks team. Filing a short postmortem in #postmortems. Action items: 1) Add canary auth token refresh smoke test; 2) Harden token refresh backoff; 3) Add rollback command aliases to runbook; 4) Add automated canary auth check.
Anna Lopez: Ack — I'll own the canary auth smoke test and add the script to smoke repo.
Kevin Patel: I'll update the runbook with the rollback command examples and alias notes.
Jamal Brooks: I'll add dashboard panels & alert tweaks for token-refresh spikes.
Mira Chen: Closing thread. Great coordination, everyone. :tada:
